html: Online LLM selection and routing that finds the most informative user–model interactions, combining bandit learning, user studies and large-scale evaluation to personalize model choice under limited feedback. Humanoid robotics pipelines on Unitree G1 and Go2 for teleoperation, demonstration collection, behavior cloning and policy evaluation, aimed at data-efficient skill acquisition.

A GPT-style multimodal foundation model fusing surgical video and kinematics to forecast robot end-effector trajectories — <5 mm RMSE one second ahead, with strong cross-task generalization. An AR surgical-training simulator combining video, kinematics and gaze with ResNet, TCN, LSTM and GCN models, improving gesture recognition and skill assessment by 18%.

Fine-tuned GPT-2, Falcon, RWKV and CodeT5 for text-to-SQL with QLoRA quantization to cut memory footprint, and built a reproducible benchmarking framework with task-specific metrics to find reliable, data-efficient adaptation strategies.

Combined BERT and ResNet-50 over clinical text and chest imaging for lung disease diagnosis, reaching 0.91 micro-F1 and cutting diagnosis time by 90%, then stress-tested multimodal robustness under textual perturbations.
